templates.title: Ultimate Camping Checklist
templates.description: A comprehensive camping checklist to ensure you have everything needed for a safe and enjoyable outdoor adventure.
templates.seoTitle: Ultimate Camping Checklist - Complete Gear & Food List
templates.seoDescription: Never forget essential camping gear again! Complete checklist with shelter, cooking, safety items and more for your perfect outdoor adventure.

items.title: Tent (appropriate for group size and weather)
items.description: Choose a tent that fits your group size with extra space for gear

contents.value:
## Tent Selection Tips

- **Capacity**: Choose tent rated for 1 more person than actual occupants
- **Seasonality**: 3-season for spring/summer/fall, 4-season for winter
- **Weight**: Consider weight if backpacking vs car camping
- **Setup**: Practice setup at home before your trip

subItems.title: Check all tent poles are included

items.title: Sleeping bag (rated for expected temperatures)
items.description: Temperature rating should be 10-15°F below expected nighttime lows

items.title: Sleeping pad or air mattress
items.description: Provides insulation from ground and comfort for better sleep

items.title: Pillow or inflatable pillow
items.description: Don't forget comfort items for quality rest

items.title: Tarp or footprint
items.description: Protects tent bottom and provides extra covered space

items.title: Camping stove and fuel
items.description: Portable cooking solution for preparing meals

items.title: Cookware and utensils
items.description: Pots, pans, plates, cups, and eating utensils

items.title: Cooler with ice
items.description: Keep perishable foods cold and safe to eat

items.title: Water containers and purification
items.description: Adequate drinking water for entire trip duration

contents.value: **Water Planning**: Plan for 1 gallon per person per day for drinking, cooking, and cleaning. Bring water purification tablets or filter if using natural water sources.

items.title: Food for all meals and snacks
items.description: Plan and pack all meals, snacks, and drinks for the entire trip

items.title: Weather-appropriate clothing
items.description: Layer system for changing conditions

items.title: Appropriate footwear
items.description: Hiking boots/shoes plus camp shoes

items.title: Personal hygiene items
items.description: Biodegradable soap, toothbrush, toilet paper, etc.

items.title: Sunscreen and insect repellent
items.description: Protection from sun and bugs

items.title: First aid kit
items.description: Well-stocked medical kit for outdoor emergencies

contents.value:
## Essential First Aid Items

- Bandages and gauze
- Antiseptic wipes
- Pain relievers
- Allergy medication
- Medical tape
- Emergency contact information

items.title: Multi-tool or knife
items.description: Versatile tool for various camping tasks

items.title: Rope or paracord

items.title: Flashlight/headlamp and extra batteries
items.description: Hands-free lighting is essential for safety

items.description: Waterproof matches, lighter, tinder

items.title: Trash bags and recycling bags
items.description: Leave no trace - pack out all waste

items.title: Camp chairs or seating

items.description: Activities for downtime and bad weather

items.title: Camera or phone for photos
items.description: Capture memories of your adventure

items.title: Maps and navigation tools
items.description: Know where you are and where you're going
